name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd.
about: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, a solar independent power producing company, engages in the develops, constructs, owns, operates, and maintains grid-connected renewable energy projects in India. The company owns and operates solar and wind energy projects with a total installed capacity of 2,982 MW; and 1,324 MWh of battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. It is also developing and constructing solar and wind energy projects with a total capacity of 2,850 MW; and 12 GWh of BESS projects. In addition, the company is involved in the firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE)/hybird projects. Further, it provides engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as operation and maintenance services. It serves central and state government-backed entities, and government-backed corporations. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Gurugram, India. ACME Solar Holdings

verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: PE 38 is 69% above the sector median, but its ROCE and growth largely justify that premium.
High leverage (D/E 3.9x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
Since 2024, most of the 33% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 23 → 38), not earnings growth (4% a year).
